facts.fact: The document says the USAID GHSC-PSM project is still transferring the skills to administer the national eLMIS to government staff, with administrators yet to be identified to take over its management from the project.

systems.country_label: National electronic health logistics management information system

GIN.note: The national eLMIS is a stock and logistics system, a single function, not routine patient reporting or a patient record.
A logistics system with no stated link to routine health reporting.
No private money amount is stated.
